text: The Ikom language, also known as Olulumo-Ikom or Lulumo, is a Bantoid language belonging to the Upper Cross River subgroup of the Benue-Congo branch within the Niger-Congo family, spoken primarily by the Olulumo-Ikom people in southern Nigeria.
